mapper.select: SELECT 'WALLET' AS recipient_type, w.wallet_id AS recipient_id, u.name AS recipient_name, w.wallet_number AS account_number, u.invite_code AS user_code FROM users u JOIN wallets w ON w.child_id = u.user_id WHERE u.invite_code = #{keyword} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND w.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT 'WALLET' AS recipient_type, w.wallet_id AS recipient_id, u.name AS recipient_name, w.wallet_number AS account_number, u.invite_code AS user_code FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.user_id = w.child_id WHERE w.wallet_number = #{keyword} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND w.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN wh.counterparty_wallet_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('999:', counterparty_wallet.wallet_number) ELSE CONCAT(wh.target_bank_code, ':', wh.target_account_number) END AS recipient_key FROM wallet_histories wh INNER JOIN wallets sender_wallet ON sender_wallet.id = wh.wallet_id LEFT JOIN wallets counterparty_wallet ON counterparty_wallet.id = wh.counterparty_wallet_id WHERE sender_wallet.child_id = #{childId} AND wh.transaction_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND wh.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY recipient_key ) recent

SELECT recent.recipient_name AS recipientName, recent.bank_code AS bankCode, recent.recipient_number AS recipientNumber, recent.created_at AS transferredAt FROM ( SELECT wh.id, wh.counterparty_name AS recipient_name, CASE WHEN wh.counterparty_wallet_id IS NOT NULL THEN '999' ELSE wh.target_bank_code END AS bank_code, CASE WHEN wh.counterparty_wallet_id IS NOT NULL THEN counterparty_wallet.wallet_number ELSE wh.target_account_number END AS recipient_number, wh.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN wh.counterparty_wallet_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('999:', counterparty_wallet.wallet_number) ELSE CONCAT(wh.target_bank_code, ':', wh.target_account_number) END ORDER BY wh.created_at DESC, wh.id DESC ) AS row_num FROM wallet_histories wh INNER JOIN wallets sender_wallet ON sender_wallet.id = wh.wallet_id LEFT JOIN wallets counterparty_wallet ON counterparty_wallet.id = wh.counterparty_wallet_id WHERE sender_wallet.child_id = #{childId} AND wh.transaction_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND wh.status = 'SUCCESS' ) recent WHERE recent.row_num = 1 ORDER BY recent.created_at DESC, recent.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
